overview: Host John Petrella interviewed Chris Summa, a recovery coach for the Medford Health Department, about his personal journey of recovery and the support resources, groups, and events available to Medford residents.

items.title: Guest Introduction
items.summary: Host John Petrella introduced Chris Summa, a recovery coach representing the Medford Health Department and North Suffolk Community Services.

items.title: Personal Background and Recovery Journey
items.summary: Chris Summa shared his personal history with substance use, working as a police officer, hitting rock bottom, and finding recovery through support groups.

items.title: Role with Medford Health Department
items.summary: Summa described his role as a substance recovery coach, highlighting support groups he leads at Medford City Hall and the First Baptist Church.

items.title: Medford Connects Community Engagement
items.summary: Summa outlined how the Medford Connects community engagement team linked approximately 8,000 residents to various city services and resources over the past year.

items.title: Support Group Structure and Philosophy
items.summary: Summa detailed his interactive and supportive approach to running the weekly All Recovery support group meetings.

items.title: Advice for Entering Recovery
items.summary: Summa discussed the various paths to recovery and offered advice to those seeking help, urging them to take the first step despite fear.

items.title: Overcoming Stigma and Professional Challenges
items.summary: Summa spoke on the challenges of substance use stigma and how he strives to lead by example and promote self-acceptance.

items.title: Upcoming Recovery Fest Event
items.summary: Summa announced Medford's upcoming Recovery Fest on September 12 at the Condon Shell, featuring food, games, speakers, and resource tables.

items.title: Department Contact Information
items.summary: Summa provided his direct phone number, email, and meeting location details for residents seeking assistance.

items.title: Episode Conclusion
items.summary: Petrella concluded the program by thanking Summa and sharing broadcast and social media information for Medford Happenings.
